sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 55.55% (USD 11.79M cumulative volume) and Lula at 43.50% (USD 12.18M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT. The gap is 12.05pp, against 18.35pp in the reading confirmed on 23/Sep at 11:54 BRT, and it is the third day running that it narrows, after the 22.40pp of 21/Sep.
sentimento.text2: ⭐ THAT IS 6.30pp OF NARROWING IN A SINGLE STEP, and since 04/Sep, when this record began, it is the largest narrowing between two consecutive certified readings, and almost twice the second largest, 3.35pp from 21 to 22/Sep. Lula rises 3.00pp raw and 3.15pp normalised, and Flávio Bolsonaro gives up 3.30pp raw and 3.15pp normalised. ⚖️ Here the raw and the normalised figures tell the SAME story, unlike 23/Sep: the sum of the pair barely moved, from 99.35 to 99.05, so there is no overpricing redistributing movement. ⚠️ Neither of them is at an extreme: Flávio Bolsonaro is 6.15pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep, and Lula is 9.00pp from his floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr.
sentimento.text3: 🗳️ SIX NATIONAL POLLS WERE RELEASED ON 24/Sep AND THEY DO NOT AGREE ON WHO LEADS EITHER ROUND. In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) the spread runs from Lula 40% to 33% at Alfa/TMC through to Flávio Bolsonaro 40.4% to 38.4% at Futura, passing 41% to 37% at Real Time, 41% to 39% at PoderData, 40% to 36% at Datafolha and a 43% tie at Palver. In the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) it runs from Lula 47% to 45% at Datafolha, the only one that puts him ahead, through to Flávio Bolsonaro 49.4% to 43.7% at Futura, and that is the only one of the six in which the distance falls outside the poll own margin. 🔑 The comparison that holds is each house against its own previous wave, and it comes out 3 to 3: Lula gained ground at Datafolha, Palver and PoderData and lost at Real Time, Futura and Alfa.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 55.55% in the winner contract (USD 11.79M cumulative volume), down 3.30pp raw and 3.15pp normalised in the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT. His price is 6.15pp from the top of the series, 61.70% on 21/Sep, and 33.55pp from the floor, 22.00% on 03/Jul. ⭐ In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he went the opposite way and RISES 4.00pp raw, to 75.50% (USD 1.14M), the largest move of any contract in this round, but there the raw figure overstates it: the sum of that pair inflated from 97.35 to 100.00 and the normalised move is 2.05pp. In the polls he leads the first round in one of the six national polls of the day and the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four of them.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 43.50% in the winner contract (USD 12.18M cumulative volume), up 3.00pp raw and 3.15pp normalised in the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT. ⚠️ It is not an extreme: his price is 24.00pp from the top of the series, 67.50% on 16/Aug, and 9.00pp from the floor, 34.50% on 25/Apr. 🔴 In the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he gives up 1.35pp raw and 2.05pp normalised, to 24.50% (USD 0.98M), and there the raw figure understates his loss, because that pair inflated from 97.35 to 100.00. In the polls he leads the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in one of the six national polls of the day, Datafolha, by 47% to 45%.
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 IN THE [FIRST ROUND](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) THIRD PLACE CONTRACT ALMOST NOTHING MOVED: Renan Santos stays at the same 44.00% (USD 0.41M cumulative volume), Augusto Cury rises 0.10pp, to 39.95% (USD 0.27M), and the distance between them NARROWS from 4.15pp to 4.05pp. Across five certified readings that distance was 19.95pp, 5.25pp, 3.05pp, 4.15pp and now 4.05pp. Ronaldo Caiado gives up 0.50pp, to 14.00% (USD 0.17M), and keeps third place; Romeu Zema rises 0.05pp, to 0.35% (USD 0.08M), a move below the 0.5% noise threshold. 🗳️ And the six national polls of the day give the third way readings the price does not see: at Futura, Ronaldo Caiado passed Augusto Cury in the first round and beats Lula by 46.5% to 42.4% head to head, and PoderData has Augusto Cury beating Lula by 45% to 42%.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT (25/Sep, 01:45 UTC), with the presidential book totalling USD 154.90M cumulative across 19 contracts. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move goes the one normalised by the sum of the pair, because in a binary contract the sum of the two sides moves on its own. 🗳️ The polling side of the divergence chart uses ONE national poll, not the average of the six: the rule is the most recent one with ties broken by the largest sample, which in this round gives Palver, n=5,000, and the choice is declared in the chart itself.

inss.text1: 🔴 THERE IS NO NEW ACT CONFIRMED BY TWO INDEPENDENT SOURCES IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) FRAUD INQUIRY ON 24/Sep. What stands is still the act of 12/Sep, in which Edson Fachin took over as rapporteur of the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and the procedural suspension he ordered also reaches the INSS cases.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 WHAT LINKED THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) TO THE MASTER CASE ON 24/Sep IS THE PLANE, and the link is about people, not process: G1 and Gazeta do Povo report that Flávio Bolsonaro travelled in 2025 on a plane linked to Daniel Vorcaro and to a lawyer under investigation in the INSS fraud case. The senator says the aircraft belonged to a lawyer friend of his. ⚖️ And on 22/Sep the Federal Court of Accounts ordered the INSS to strengthen data security after a leak, an act reported by Folha de S.Paulo, unrelated to the fraud inquiry.
inss.impactoLula: The approval benchmark of this panel is still the [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) poll of 21/Sep, [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) registration BR-06004/2026, with 44% approval against 50% disapproval, and on 24/Sep there was no new wave from the house. ⚠️ THREE OF THE SIX NATIONAL POLLS OF THE DAY MEASURED APPROVAL, and the spread of disapproval is wider than that of approval: Alfa/TMC with 46% against 50%, Futura/100% Cidades with 44.2% against 53.3% and Palver with 44% against 55%. That is 2 points of distance in approval and 5 in disapproval, between houses that surveyed the same electorate in the same week. Adding Datafolha of 17/Sep, Quaest of 21/Sep and AtlasIntel of 23/Sep, approval measured by six houses in eight days runs from 44% to 48%.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this one: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep and 44% against 50% on 21/Sep. The 5 point fall stopped and gave 1 back, within the margin. ⭐ And the ASSESSMENT benchmark moved the opposite way in the SAME Quaest wave: the negative rose from 38% to 42%, the positive from 32% to 33% and the fair reading fell from 27% to 23%. These are two different questions and they do not add up. 📌 Alfa of 24/Sep adds a third question, which also does not add up with the other two: 55% say Lula does not deserve re-election against 43% who back a new term.
inss.conclusao: What this round measures on the subject is about polls and about people, not about acts: there is no new act confirmed by two independent sources in the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) fraud inquiry on 24/Sep, and what did appear was the plane link, which runs through a lawyer under investigation in that case. In the polls, three of the six national polls of the day measured approval and the spread between them is still wider than the movement of any single one.

bancoMaster.text1: 🔴 ON 24/Sep ESTADÃO PUBLISHED MESSAGES EXTRACTED FROM DANIEL VORCARO PHONE, and they reach both sides of the presidential race. On Flávio Bolsonaro side, the exchanges show four attempts by him to contact the banker between 13 and 16 November 2025, in the days before Vorcaro arrest, on 17 November 2025, when he was trying to leave the country. Gazeta do Povo confirmed the authenticity of the exchanges with sources close to the investigation. Part of the conversations concerns the financing of the film Dark Horse, and the senator confirmed a September 2025 exchange about it, citing a private financing contract that has not been made public.
bancoMaster.text2: 📅 ON LULA SIDE, THE SAME MATERIAL SHOWS AN EFFORT TO BRING THE BANKER CLOSER TO THE GOVERNMENT by a lawyer, including thanks for whisky sent by the banker and the offer of a new meeting, which Valor Econômico, O Globo and Gazeta do Povo reported. At an event in Rio de Janeiro, Lula replied that a president friend is the people, not Vorcaro. On the same day Flávio Bolsonaro asked the Supreme Court, in André Mendonça chambers, to investigate the relationship between Lula and Vorcaro, and his defence asked Edson Fachin to suspend the investigations that reach him. ⚖️ Also on 24/Sep, Gilmar Mendes took to the full bench of the Supreme Court a dispute over power plant court-ordered debts with an estimated impact of R$ 103 billion, after messages from the same material showed interest in the vote of one justice (O Globo, G1 and Gazeta do Povo).
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The price on this page for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 comes from the reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT, and it stands at 3.35%, with USD 0.09M cumulative volume, down 0.95pp. AFOS does not attribute the move of that contract to the news flow of the case: it measures the price and the news side by side, each with its own timestamp. 🏷️ And two facts of the day are about the calendar, not about completed acts: Gabriel Galípolo confirmed he received a summons from the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) and is due to testify in October about the case, which Folha de S.Paulo, Estadão and O Globo report, and the testimony by Daniel Vorcaro that was set for 24/Sep did not happen, with Gazeta do Povo reporting a postponement by the Federal Police at the request of the defence, which asks for ten working days to examine the evidence.
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case moved on 24/Sep through the release of investigation material, not through a decision: the messages from Daniel Vorcaro phone became public through Estadão and they reach both campaigns, and the panel records them by the date they became public, not by the date they were written. The testimony set for the day was postponed, the one by Gabriel Galípolo is set for October, and the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro pre-trial detention has been with Edson Fachin since 18/Sep, undecided.

stf.toffoli: He is the justice with the highest rejection in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão released on 23/Sep, a survey separate from the electoral one, with 1,852 adults interviewed between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin. On 24/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he voted to remove an opponent of Davi Alcolumbre from the Amapá election and that André Mendonça interrupted the ruling; the act has a single source and is recorded here as attributed. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos and of the inquiry committee request by Alessandro Vieira.
stf.moraes: The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro still has no date, suspended by a request for further review by Flávio Dino. On 22/Sep he was one of the two justices named in the inquiry committee request that Cristiano Zanin declined to unlock by injunction, and Luiz Fux was drawn as rapporteur of the case on visits by his wife and by Vorcaro to senators. On 24/Sep nothing new about him was confirmed by two independent sources.
stf.gilmar: ⚖️ ON 24/Sep HE TOOK TO THE FULL BENCH OF THE SUPREME COURT a dispute over power plant court-ordered debts with an estimated impact of R$ 103 billion, after messages from Daniel Vorcaro phone showed interest in the vote of one justice in that case (O Globo, G1 and Gazeta do Povo). On 18/Sep he had publicly admitted a meeting with Vorcaro and stated that he voted against [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) in a case he described as worth up to R$ 145 billion.
stf.dino: On 15/Sep he asked for further review in the ruling on the investigation into Alexandre de Moraes, which suspends the analysis for up to 90 days, and he had not returned the case by 24/Sep. On 22/Sep he said the right moment for the Supreme Court to examine the case on parliamentary earmarks is after the elections, which G1, O Globo and Gazeta do Povo reported.
stf.mendonca: His 76 page filing, submitted on 21/Sep, asks Edson Fachin for the summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and for consideration of opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority. On 24/Sep his chambers received the request by Flávio Bolsonaro to investigate the relationship between Lula and Daniel Vorcaro, and Folha de S.Paulo reports that he interrupted the ruling on the Amapá election. The defence of Felipe Cançado Vorcaro is pressing him to review that defendant pre-trial detention, after Fachin denied being the rapporteur.
stf.nexo: The link with the election is about the calendar and about institutions, not about the result, and the measurement this panel uses is still the one from 23/Sep. In the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Bloomberg, an electoral wave of 5,015 participants between 17 and 22/Sep, 52.3% say the Supreme Court crisis hurts Lula candidacy more and 20.8% say it hurts Flávio Bolsonaro more, with 15.5% seeing equal harm. On which group is more involved in the [Banco Master](/en/glossary#banco-master) scheme, 43.8% point to allies of Jair Bolsonaro and 43.4% point to allies of Lula, a tie within the 1.0pp margin. 🗳️ None of the six national polls of 24/Sep repeated these questions, so the measurement of the link has no new reading.
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 3.35% (USD 0.09M cumulative volume), reading confirmed on 24/Sep, 22:45 BRT, down 0.95pp. It is a thin book, and the price is 22.75pp from the top of the series, 26.10% on 11/Sep, and 1.25pp from the floor, 2.10% on 08/Jun. ⚠️ Perception of the Court, measured in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão of 23/Sep, a separate survey with 1,852 adults between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin, stands at 61% who say they do not trust the work and the justices against 27.8% who do. That house series went from 51.3% distrust in August 2025 to 60% in March and 61% now. ⛔ The panel does not link the 0.95pp fall of the contract to the news flow of the day: it measures both with their own timestamps.
stf.fachin: Since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke the pre-trial detention of Daniel Vorcaro, undecided as of 24/Sep. On 24/Sep the defence of Flávio Bolsonaro asked him to suspend the investigations that reach the senator, which O Globo reports, and CartaCapital reports that he asked the Office of the Prosecutor General to weigh in on the removal of the director general of the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf). Both acts have a single source each and are recorded here as attributed.
